@@ -238,6 +245,50 @@ mod SelfhostRust do
   def is_owned(CList(_, _)) := true
   def is_owned(_) := false
 
+  # GENERIC borrowed-set branch (`Rian.Lower.rust_owned_elem`): in a `forall` function
+  # a parameter binder is borrowed (`&T`), so when it is stored into an owned `Vec`
+  # ELEMENT position — a closed list (`[x, x]` → `vec![x.clone(), x.clone()]`) or a cons
+  # head (`[x | xs]` → `__v.insert(0, x.clone())`) — it is `.clone()`d back to an owned
+  # `T`. The borrowed set is the clause's `&`-typed plain-var params plus any cons-TAIL
+  # binder (slice ELEMENT binders are excluded — `arm_rebinds` already made them owned).
+  # Variant payloads (`Some(x)` → `.clone()` in the reference) and `Ok`/`Err` (which keep
+  # the borrow) are deferred — a generic variant payload needs the parametric-enum
+  # monomorphization that is itself out of scope.
+  def clone_clauses(Vec(Clause), Vec(Param)) Vec(Clause)
+  def clone_clauses([], _) := []
+  def clone_clauses([Clause(pats, g, body) | rest], params) :=
+    [Clause(pats, g, clone_owned(body, bset(pats, params))) | clone_clauses(rest, params)]
+
+  # the borrowed binders of a clause: a plain-var param of `&`-type, plus list-pattern
+  # cons-tail binders (always a borrowed slice).
+  def bset(Vec(RPat), Vec(Param)) Vec(String)
+  def bset([], _) := []
+  def bset(_, []) := []
+  def bset([pat | ps], [Param(_, t) | prest]) := app(pat_bset(pat, t), bset(ps, prest))
+
+  def pat_bset(RPat, String) Vec(String)
+  def pat_bset(RVar(n), t) := if borrow_type(t) do [n] else [] end
+  def pat_bset(RListP(_, LpVar(n)), _) := [n]
+  def pat_bset(_, _) := []
+
+  # rewrite owned `Vec`-element uses of a borrowed binder to `.clone()`; recurse through
+  # control structure to reach nested lists. A bare borrowed var elsewhere (a return, an
+  # operand) is left alone — the return clone is `ret_coerce`'s job.
+  def clone_owned(Core, Vec(String)) Core
+  def clone_owned(CList(es, LClose), bs) := CList(clone_elems(es, bs), LClose)
+  def clone_owned(CList(es, LCons(t)), bs) := CList(clone_elems(es, bs), LCons(clone_owned(t, bs)))
+  def clone_owned(CIf(c, t, e), bs) := CIf(clone_owned(c, bs), clone_owned(t, bs), clone_owned(e, bs))
+  def clone_owned(leaf, _) := leaf
+
+  # an owned element: a borrowed bare var here is `.clone()`d; anything else recurses.
+  def clone_elems(Vec(Core), Vec(String)) Vec(Core)
+  def clone_elems([], _) := []
+  def clone_elems([e | rest], bs) := [clone_elem(e, bs) | clone_elems(rest, bs)]
+
+  def clone_elem(Core, Vec(String)) Core
+  def clone_elem(CId(n), bs) := if member(n, bs) do CClone(CId(n)) else CId(n) end
+  def clone_elem(e, bs) := clone_owned(e, bs)
+
   # `rust_program` emits plain `fn` for every top-level function (a single Rust
   # module; the `pub?` flag is not a Rust visibility here), so it is ignored.
   def function_rs(Func) String
@@ -350,6 +401,7 @@ mod SelfhostRust do

   def used_ids(CList(es, LClose)) := used_each(es)

   ]

@@ -311,5 +317,18 @@ defmodule Rian.RustModuleFixpointTest do
              ) =~
                "add1(1, 2)"
     end
+
+    test "a generic borrowed `&T` binder is `.clone()`d into owned Vec elements", %{mod: mod} do
+      # closed Vec elements
+      assert ported(mod, "def dup(x val T) Vec(T) forall T := [x, x]") =~
+               "vec![x.clone(), x.clone()]"
+
+      # a cons head prepended onto the owned tail
+      pre = ported(mod, "def pre(x val T, xs iso Vec(T)) Vec(T) forall T := [x | xs]")
+      assert pre =~ "{ let mut __v = xs.to_vec(); __v.insert(0, x.clone()); __v }"
+
+      # a non-generic identity over a Vec does NOT clone (no borrowed-set)
+      refute ported(mod, "def keep(xs iso Vec(Int64)) Vec(Int64) := xs") =~ ".clone()"
+    end
   end
